scope: Independent source-only review of the read-only Save occluder probe and run 003 receipt. No browser, test, or build run.

A_runtime.reason: Run 003 is evidence for the earlier geometry-only probe. The newly added occluder fields and screenshot have not been exercised in this review lane.

findings: The diagnostic remains reachable only from existing-checkpoint recovery after a definitive lookup result of none. It captures the public page into local Scrape UI state, inspects Save, captures a screenshot, then exits diagnostic_only. There is no Save click, keyboard input, DOM click, attempt reservation, checkpoint update, or checkpoint deletion in this branch.

New structured diagnostics contain only viewport/target/clipped rectangles, booleans, counts, and allowlisted tag, role, data-slot, and CSS position categories. No text, attribute values, class names, IDs, organization details, page URLs, or network response bodies are returned.

The screenshot is written under ignored test-results with exclusive-create flag wx and mode 0600. If that path already exists or creation fails, the report records unavailable; the existing file is not overwritten. Screenshot capture uses read-only CDP Page.captureScreenshot.

Checkpoint recovery calls existingSaveAttempt for lstat/read validation. In the lookup-none branch, control fails out before any checkpoint-writing helper is reachable, preserving the prior reserved checkpoint. The public result records only a fixed screenshot status and allowlisted probe object.
limits: The report's blocker diagnosis is limited to a hit-test failure observed in run 003; the new occluder identity is not runtime verified here.
The private screenshot may contain visible UI text, but it remains a private ignored artifact created with mode 0600; it is not serialized into the public report.

checks: No browser, tests, build, or Save input performed in this review.
